tracking: ADR-0340 slice 3 (lane E21): API-only by the master brief for lane E21; the canary and migration controls are built by the design builder on #453

gaps.GET /v1/workflows/builder/templates/:tem: shows a template's open canary, its two versions and how many new instances each side has served
gaps.POST /v1/workflows/builder/templates/:te: ends a template's canary: promote it to every new instance, or roll it back to the stable definition
gaps.POST /v1/workflows/instances/:instanceId: dry-runs (default) or files a governed migration of a running workflow instance to another template version (approved by another admin in the approvals queue)
gaps.GET /v1/workflows/instances/:instanceId/: lists a workflow instance's migration requests with the plan and diff each was filed against
